payload.text: `PremiumStyle::flip_orientation` is a self-inverse (involution) mapping the premium style under base/quote currency-pair inversion: DomesticPips↔ForeignPips and PercentForeign↔PercentDomestic. Applying it twice is the identity (DomesticPips→ForeignPips→DomesticPips; PercentForeign→PercentDomestic→PercentForeign), so re-quoting the same option in the inverted pair orientation and back recovers the original premium style exactly — the orientation-invariance property the pair-universe view relies on (docs/CONVENTIONS.md §pair universe). It is a `const fn` total match with no wildcard. Pure: reads only `self`, returns the flipped enum, no mutation.
